Scope: 20 ready-built factories of 900 m² each in five blocks (A to E), with site works, networks, external works, roads and landscaping.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. At the 19-Oct-2026 data date the project is 97.2% complete against 96.5% planned, 0.7% ahead. Engineering, procurement and mobilisation are complete, construction is on plan at 96.4%, and testing and commissioning is ahead of plan.

Data notes

  • The weekly report workbook (No. 41, dated 19-Oct-2026) has no text version in MD Files. Its figures for the S-curve, manpower, cost and invoicing, and health, safety and quality could not be used, so those sections are left out. Contractor, consultant and project manager are not named in any text file. Only its photos were used.
  • This report uses only the latest upload (W4), so no previous-week figures are available: progress this week and the this-week column show "–".
  • Physical progress comes from the P6 labour units in the P6 update report: 116,740 budgeted, 112,642 planned and 113,420 earned man-hours.
  • The file names use project code HAL1-05-009, while the P6 update file is coded HAL1-05-10.
  • The P6 update file gives a planned start of 14-Mar-2023, while the project started on 04-Dec-2025. Its start and finish dates for completed activities are later than their actual dates (for example, project start 29-Dec-2025 against 04-Dec-2025 actual).
  • Procurement earned and planned man-hours (27,496) exceed its budget (27,460), because the short-lead mechanical purchase orders show 2,480 earned against 2,444 budgeted.
  • The "Completion of Engineering and Materials" milestone is still open in P6, forecast for 19-Oct-2026, although all engineering and procurement activities have actual finishes.
  • Asphalt wearing course and tack coat show 100% complete but are still marked in progress, with no actual finish.
  • Block B's discipline totals add up to 10,655 earned man-hours, against 10,654 on the block line (rounding).
  • Report week: the weekly report states its number as 41. Counting whole weeks from project start (04-Dec-2025) to the data date gives week 45.
  • The photos carry a camera date stamp of 18-Oct-2026 and no GPS stamp.
